title: DBKL to collaborate with international agencies to overcome flash floods, says Shahidan | The Star
text:
DBKL to collaborate with international agencies to overcome flash floods, says Shahidan | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The Kuala Lumpur City Hall (DBKL) will work closely with various international agencies as part of efforts to reduce climate change effects, as well as to overcome flash flood issues in the capital.
Federal Territories Minister Datuk Seri Dr Shahidan Kassim said besides the Tokyo Metropolitan Government (TMG), the City Hall also has collaborated with the Institute For Global Environmental Strategies to help achieve the target of reducing 70% carbon emission by 2030.
